text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Win Variation—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking where Win Variation pointed, there 
was a crane game filled with plushies 
styled after Umamusume.
choice_data_list:
Are you interested in Paka Puchi, by any 
chance?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I thought that stuffed animal... if 
it were in the ballet dance studio my 
parents run, the little kids might really 
like it.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Some of the students are still quite 
young, after all. When separated from 
their parents, they start crying..."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
So our ballet studio actually has a lot of 
toys for small children. It's been like 
that ever since I was a student there.
choice_data_list:
You really do look out for the little 
kids, huh.

You really do look out for the little 
kids, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Thanks to that, many girls 
fall in love with ballet from a young age.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
If I stay lonely like this, there's no way 
I can ever learn to love ballet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seemed to want as many students as 
possible to enjoy dancing ballet. ...I 
want to do what I can to support her.
choice_data_list: Alright! I'm gonna give this game a try!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Got it! I'll be cheering you on!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
